class="liveRecName">${escAttr(r.x.name)}${r.planned===false?'<span class="unplannedTag">Nearby option</span>':''}</div><div class="liveRecMeta">${r.walk!=null?`${r.walk} min walk · `:''}${escAttr(r.x.area||'')}${r.live?.lastUpdated?` · updated ${escAttr(isoToParkTime(r.live.lastUpdated))}`:''}</div><div class="liveHeroRow"><button class="tinyAction" onclick="setLiveHere('${r.id}')">I’m here</button>${r.x.map&&MAPS[r.x.park]?`<a class="tinyAction" href="${MAPS[r.x.park]}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">Map ${r.x.map}</a>`:''}${canEditPlanner()?(r.planned===false?`<button class="tinyAction" onclick="addLiveSuggestion('${r.id}')">+ Add to plan</button>`:`<button class="tinyAction" onclick="openQuickSheet('attraction',${r.bi},'${r.id}')">Options</button>`):''}</div></div><span class="waitPill ${waitClass(r.live?.standby,r.live?.status)}">${escAttr(waitLabel(r.live))}</span></div>`).join(''):`<div class="liveEmpty">${pd?'No remaining planned attractions fit the current filters.':'Load live park data to see waits and route suggestions.'}</div>`}${pd?.attribution?`<div class="sourceCredit"><a href="${pd.attribution_url}" target="_blank" rel="noopener">${escAttr(pd.attribution)}</a> · live data is best-effort; Disney’s app remains the official source.</div>`:''}</div>
